Facility Operations Runner

CloudKitchens

About the role

CloudKitchens is looking for a Facility Operations Runner to keep our delivery kitchen facility running smoothly. You will move orders from kitchens to couriers, restock supplies and keep shared spaces clean and safe. This is an on-site role.

What you will do

  • Hand off orders to delivery couriers quickly and accurately
  • Restock packaging and cleaning supplies across the facility
  • Report maintenance issues to the facility manager

What we look for

  • Comfortable standing and walking for a full shift
  • Able to lift up to 50 pounds
  • Reliable and friendly with a customer-first attitude

We also hire part-time runners for weekend shifts; tell us your availability when you apply.

Pay: $15 - $19 per hour
